context_for_next_testing_agent: Per-Patent Enforcement Policy is fully functional. The Guard Shadow tab in Admin panel shows 5 policy rows with Promote/Demote/Clear buttons. The policy state is persisted in MongoDB (guard_policy_state collection) and read by the IP contract via a 30s process-local cache. Conviction Calibration tab has been polished: stats grid removed, counts inlined, fallback section collapsible. Smart orders with mode=paper bypass the guard (paper trading is sandboxed). The proof_chain_entity_id is persisted on smart order rows for OUTCOME_VERIFIED tracking on close.

code_review_notes.guard_policy_store: Mongo-backed override store with 30s TTL cache. VALID_FLAGS set enforces flag validation. History capped at 50 entries.
code_review_notes.risedual_ip_logic: EnforcementPolicy.from_env() merges env defaults with cached Mongo overrides. refresh_cache_if_stale() called once per decision.
code_review_notes.admin_guard_shadow: 3 new endpoints: GET /policy, POST /policy/promote, POST /policy/clear. All owner-only. Force cache refresh after promote/clear.
code_review_notes.smart_order_service: proof_chain_entity_id persisted on order row. cancel_smart_order calls record_manual_order_outcome for OUTCOME_VERIFIED.
code_review_notes.conviction_calibration: Stats grid removed, counts inlined as subtitle, fallback section wrapped in <details> with open={!hasConvictionData}.
